positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on the core web extension team to help build out the UI for the chrome extension. The core web extension is a multi chain supported crypto wallet that allows users to send, swap, and bridge their crypto across the various chains such as bitcoin, ethereum, and avalanche.

Also helped develop the core web platform, which is a feature rich dapp allowing users to connect their web wallets and view all of their cypto in one place across multiple chains. Also allows users to view other users balances as well as NFT holdings. Built using Typescript and an internal component library built on top of Material UI.

Worked 1:1 with product designers and product managers to develop features and gather feedback about products in development.

While at Ava I learned about various blockchain technologies and how applications interact with the blockchain, through the use of dApps, web wallets, and even ledger devices.
positions.insights: Skills: Startups · User Interface Design · JavaScript · TypeScript · Front-end Engineering · Web Engineering · Front-End Development · React

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Cacheflow is a sales automation tool helping sales go from quote to close faster and more seamless.

Worked with our small team of engineers to help build our main product offering using Typescript/Tailwind on the front end and Java on the backend.

Had weekly product design/review meetings to provide feedback to the design team and help establish timelines for product releases.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
positions.description:
Worked on the spend management team for my entire tenure at Divvy. Spend management was one of the most important aspects of the Divvy product. We were responsible for the budgeting platform, which all other products were derived from (bill pay, transactions, reimbursements).

Helped lead the spend management platform development, mentoring junior engineers, and meeting with various customers to refine the spend experience on our platform.

Contributed to our in house internal component library (skylab), which was built using React and Storybook. This component library was used across our organization in multiple different projects in order to maintain app wide consistency.
